There's a stone carving that depicts three identical tairns mounted on the alter of the Grand Carmeenian Forest...|Davo Sculdun describing the Lost Tairn in his collection|<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />}}
The '''Grand Carmeenian Forest''' was a location in [[Carmeen]]. A stone carving mounted on the alter of the forest depicted three tairns. One of which was later known as the [[Lost Tairn]] after it was left being during the [[Battle of Carmeen]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grand Carmeenian Forest was mentioned in the [[What a Festive Evening|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
